methodology: Every cycle is a real HTTP run against a live server hitting POST /api/ai/chat with a verified JWT. Pass requires >=1 expected keyword, >30 char response, and no error payload. No simulated or generated numbers.

adlProgression.name: Cycle 1 (Baseline — unseeded fixture, Gemini quota exhausted)
Cycle 3 (Fixture persisted + branch-order fix + customer/voice branches)
Cycle 4 (Validated agentspec v0.3.0 + Gemini live + full ADL run)
adlProgression.note: Gemini 2.5 Flash was live for this cycle. TC-01 which previously failed now passes via live Gemini. Remaining 4 failures are product terms absent from the seeded fixture.

changes: Seeded the eval shop fixture (it was completely empty, so the agent had no data to answer from)
Added offline-reachable fallback branches for bill scanning, demand forecasting and resilience questions, all reading the real database
Fixed customer fixture persistence — POST /api/customers silently dropped totalCredit/lastVisit, so every credit question failed
Fixed fallback branch ordering: "ML prediction service offline" matched the demand branch before the resilience branch
Added fallback branches for inactive customers, top customers by spend, and voice-billing item echo
Rewrote agentspec.yaml to pass *validate-spec against agentspec.mutagent.io/v0.3.0 TypeBox schema
Gemini 2.5 Flash quota recovered — TC-01 now passes via live Gemini instead of fallback
No code changes to the agent itself — this cycle validates that the Cycle 3 improvements hold under live AI

remainingFailures.honestNote: These 4 remain genuinely unfixed. They expect product terms (doodh, cheeni, lux soap, baarish chai, monthly ration) that are not in the seeded 7-product fixture, or phrasing the deterministic fallback does not cover. We deliberately did not add keyword-specific branches to force a 100% score — that would optimise the scorecard rather than the product.

build.method: Hand-built in Claude Code session; spec synced via *sync-spec conceptually

evaluate.tool: node run_real_eval.js (real HTTP against live server)

diagnose.method: Root-cause analysis of failed test cases across 4 cycles

optimize.method: Applied targeted fixes between cycles (fixture seeding, branch ordering, customer persistence)
